Why Zensar?

We’re a bunch of hardworking, fun-loving, people-oriented technology enthusiasts. We love what we do, and we’re passionate about helping our clients thrive in an increasingly complex digital world. Zensar is an organization focused on building relationships with our clients and with each other—and happiness is at the core of everything we do. In fact, we’re so into happiness that we’ve created a Global Happiness Council, and we send out a Happiness Survey to our employees each year. We’ve learned that employee happiness requires more than a competitive paycheck, and our employee value proposition—grow, own, achieve, learn (GOAL)—lays out the core opportunities we seek to foster for every employee. Teamwork and collaboration are critical to Zensar’s mission and success, and our teams work on a diverse and challenging mix of technologies across a broad industry spectrum. These industries include banking and financial services, high-tech and manufacturing, healthcare, insurance, retail, and consumer services. Our employees enjoy flexible work arrangements and a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), among other benefits. If you are looking for a place to have an immediate impact, to grow and contribute, where we work hard, play hard, and support each other, consider joining team Zensar!

Zensar is looking for a Applied AI Developer in the United States (Hybrid). This position is open for Full Time with excellent benefits and professional growth opportunities.

About the Role

Think AI-first — assess where agentic approaches genuinely outperform conventional solutions, then own the quality bar: build automated evals, simulation tests, and regression frameworks that keep our AI systems reliable and improving as they scale.
Design agentic systems — tool orchestration, agent reasoning, memory, MCP integrations, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Define and implement AI governance patterns — guardrails, data lineage, auditability, and responsible AI practices that ensure our agentic systems are safe, compliant, and trustworthy.
Drive adoption through pilots, proofs-of-concept, and scalable implementations across engineering teams.
Collaborate with various business functions, product, security, and platform teams to translate AI use cases into production-grade, end-to-end solutions.

Experience:

8+ years of professional software engineering, with at least 2 years focused on applied AI in production systems.
Proficient in Python and/or Go; comfortable reading and writing in the other.
Proven experience building and scaling multi-agent or agent-driven systems in production — real-world operational ownership, not just simple LLM workflows.
Hands-on experience with modern agent ecosystems, including frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Google ADK, Mastra, Claude Agent SDK), observability and evals tooling (e.g., Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust), MCP implementations, and leading AI SDKs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic).
Strong systems and backend architecture fundamentals — designing scalable, reliable systems and handling infrastructure, performance, failure modes, cost, and deployment concerns.
Good understanding of cloud-native environments (GCP and/or AWS) — compute, storage, networking, and managed AI services.
Experience designing and integrating with enterprise APIs (REST, GraphQL) including authentication and authorization patterns (OAuth2, SAML, API keys, RBAC). Comfortable working with backend databases (SQL and NoSQL) — writing queries, understanding data models, and building data access layers that enforce role-based access control.
Strong cross-functional collaborator and communicator, able to partner with Product, Operations, and domain experts to deliver end-to-end systems with measurable real-world impact.
A force-multiplier on the team — you raise the bar for clarity of thinking, system design standards, and team execution.

Education:

Bachelor’s / Master’s Degree – Information Technology

1. Completion of take-home assignment
2. In person interview with the Hiring Team

jobs.title: Quality Lead, Gen AI
jobs.description:
The quality of data underpins Generative AI programs. At Scale, Quality Control is responsible for ensuring data we deliver to the world’s leading AI customers is state of the art.

As a Quality Control Lead, you’ll own that call for some of our highest-impact Generative AI programs. You'll lead a large team of quality control specialists to measure and improve quality across these programs, from multilingual post-training data to agentic RL environments. You will work on frontier-level problems – the programs you work on train the models people are talking about.

You will hold delivery teams accountable across our highest-impact projects – helping solve nuanced quality issues, as well as leading strategic initiatives to enable reliable, scalable operations across the organization.

What You’ll Do

Lead and grow a team of quality specialists - hire, coach and calibrate this team of specialists.
Turn unclear customer requirements into clear standards - work with delivery teams to interpret and improve customer requirements, and then turn that into measurable signals of data quality.
Run the quality system. Own the daily operation: plan and allocate workforce capacity, produce quality reporting, measure productivity and efficiency, and drive quality control policies.
Analyzing quality trends. Identify, root-cause, and elevate defect patterns that delivery teams can take action on.
Build the future of QC. Our team already leverages agentic capabilities, but you will help decide and lead what gets built next to continue to scale and optimize our quality operations.

Ideally you’d have

A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Operations, or a related field.
3+ years leading teams or scaling large operational/technical processes.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills (particularly in SQL) with attention to detail.
Experience building systems, processes, and teams across multiple customer segments or product lines.
A hands-on background in product management, operations management, program management, or top-tier management consulting.
Proven experience taking initiative in cross-functional technical environments.

Nice to haves:

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Operations, or a related field.
Experience in AI/ML services, data annotation or model evaluation.
Experience in a fast-growing, less-structured startup environment.
Experience building teams from the ground up.

Compensation packages at Scale for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position and may be inclusive of several career levels at Scale; it will be determined during the interview process based on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, interview performance, and relevant education or training. Scale employees in eligible roles are also granted equity based compensation, subject to Board of Director approval. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process, and confirm whether the hired role will be eligible for equity grant. You'll also receive benefits including, but not limited to: comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, a learning and development stipend, and generous PTO. Additionally, this role may be eligible for additional benefits such as a commuter stipend.

Please reference the job posting's subtitle for where this position will be located. For pay transparency purposes, the base salary range for this full-time position in the locations of San Francisco, New York, Seattle is:

$134,400—$168,000 USD

PLEASE NOTE:
Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.

At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist - Experimentation & Causal Inference
to serve as the statistical brain behind our rapidly growing experimentation program. You will own the methodology layer that ensures every experiment we run is trustworthy, sensitive, and correctly interpreted.
You will NOT be building infrastructure or writing backend services — our platform engineering team handles that. Your job is to design, validate, and continuously improve the statistical frameworks that sit on top of the platform. You will be the person the team turns to when they ask "Can we trust this result?" — and you will build the automated systems that answer that question before anyone needs to ask.
Team context:
You will join a team of data scientists and platform engineers within the Big Data group, reporting to the Head of Big Data. The experimentation platform engineering team implements your specifications into production systems.

Responsibility

Guardrail Metrics & SRM Detection

Design and maintain automated anomaly detection for live experiments — including Sample Ratio Mismatch (SRM) checks and traffic split validation.
Define alerting thresholds and circuit-breaking criteria so compromised experiments are flagged or stopped before polluting decisions.
Define and validate guardrail metrics (sensitivity, directionality, interpretability) that protect the business during every experiment.

Variance Reduction & Sensitivity

Implement and iterate on CUPED and related pre-experiment covariate adjustment methods to reduce metric variance.
Develop techniques to remove noise from user historical behavior, enabling faster detection of true treatment effects — especially in limited-traffic or high-priority scenarios.
Example of impact we are targeting:
Shorten average experiment duration from 14 days to 9 days, unlocking 40%+ more experiments per quarter.

Continuous A/A Experiment Monitoring

Design and run continuous A/A experiments as an always-on health check for the data pipeline (from client-side event reporting through message queues to the real-time data warehouse).
Monitor metric baseline volatility and pipeline stability, ensuring the instrumentation layer remains trustworthy over time. You define what "healthy" looks like; the platform team implements the monitoring infrastructure.

Other responsibilities

Partner with product, engineering, and growth teams on experiment design: sample size calculations, metric selection, duration estimation, and result interpretation. Advise on causal inference methods (DID, synthetic control, RDD) when randomization is not feasible.
Translate your methods into specifications, validation scripts, and decision frameworks that the team can operationalize — enabling experiment owners to self-serve while maintaining rigor.

Requirements

Education:
MS or PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, Economics (Econometrics), Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
Experience:
3+ years of industry experience designing and analyzing online controlled experiments at a tech company with meaningful user scale (not exclusively survey experiments or clinical trials).
Core Statistical Knowledge:
Solid foundations in hypothesis testing, power analysis, multiple testing correction, and sequential testing. Hands-on experience with at least two of: variance reduction methods (CUPED or similar), sample ratio mismatch detection, or continuous data quality monitoring for experiments.
Programming:
Proficient in Python (scipy, statsmodels, or equivalent) for statistical analysis and simulation. Comfortable writing complex SQL (window functions, CTEs) for data extraction and validation.
Communication & Collaboration:
Ability to explain complex statistical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, translate business questions into rigorous experimental designs, and define clear specifications so engineers can implement your methods in production.
AI-Native Workflow:
Strong AI Sense — extensive hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, OpenClaw, or similar). Demonstrated ability to leverage AI assistants to automate repetitive analytical tasks, accelerate code development, and build self-serve tooling faster. You treat AI tools as a daily productivity multiplier, not a novelty.

Familiarity with Bayesian experimentation frameworks or multi-armed bandit approaches.
Understanding of real-time streaming data pipelines (Kafka, Flink) — not as an engineer, but how data flow affects statistical validity.
Publications or conference presentations on experimentation methodology or causal inference (KDD, WSDM, CIKM, NeurIPS CausalML workshop, or equivalent).

jobs.description:
Dragonfli Group is a cybersecurity and IT consulting firm providing services to federal agencies and Fortune 100 enterprises. Headquartered in Washington, DC, Dragonfli supports clients in securing mission-critical systems across on-site, hybrid, and fully remote environments.

Dragonfli Group is seeking two Fraud Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join a cybersecurity analytics team supporting a large federal agency. This is a fully remote role. You will apply AI and machine learning analytics to large volumes of data from disparate sources to uncover cybersecurity threats and fraud schemes, build analytic solutions in Databricks using Python, SQL, and R, and translate complex findings into clear reporting for stakeholders at every level. The ideal candidate brings a minimum of 8 years of hands-on experience in fraud analytics, data science, or AI/ML applied to security or fraud detection, and the curiosity to find gaps in systems and processes and recommend practical remediation.

This is a multi-year contract position involving a large US federal agency. Candidates with previous federal contracting experience are preferred. U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency is required. If hired, all work related to this role must be performed within the continental U.S.

Job responsibilities:
Apply AI/ML analytic approaches to large volumes of data from disparate sources to uncover cybersecurity threats and fraud schemes against the organization.
Develop analytic solutions in Databricks using Python, SQL, and R to create, interpret, visualize, and report on complex data.
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels, from analysts to senior leadership.
Respond to ad hoc stakeholder requests to investigate concerns and deliver timely answers.
Work across business units to identify, collect, aggregate, and analyze new data sources that advance the team's mission.
Reduce the time needed to deliver analytical insights through automation and reusable analytic pipelines.

Must-Have
Minimum of 8 years of hands-on experience in fraud analytics, data science, or AI/ML applied to fraud or cybersecurity threat detection.

Demonstrated expert-level experience designing, building, and deploying AI/ML solutions for fraud or anomaly detection, developed over many years of client work delivering solutions.
Proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis and model development.
Hands-on experience with Databricks or a comparable cloud analytics platform.
Ability to communicate complex analytic results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, and to direct specialized teams of data scientists, data engineers, and business intelligence specialists.
U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency, and the ability to work from within the continental U.S.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have
Experience with Azure Databricks.
Experience with R, Tableau, and AWS.
Experience with MLOps and model lifecycle management.
Experience designing solutions that use large language models or computer vision in secure environments.
Experience with data strategy and governance.
Experience managing delivery across multiple concurrent engagements.
Previous federal contracting experience.
Relevant certifications (for example, cloud, data, or security certifications).

Skill(s):

Technical Skills
AI/ML for fraud detection and anomaly detection
Data science and advanced analytics
Databricks (Azure preferred)
Python, SQL, and R
Data visualization and reporting (Tableau preferred)
Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure)

We are seeking a skilled Generative AI Engineer to join our dynamic team who is eager to solve enterprise problems with GenAI. We are embarking upon many critical AI initiatives to help improve employee productivity, developer productivity, and improve business growth. Experience with enterprise search or low-code / no-code AI platforms like Glean or Gemini Enterprise Apps — including management, configuration, and developer support
Experience building or operating AI agents or agentic workflows using frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, or custom implementations

Experience with AWS cloud services and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform
Experience building CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins

Preferred

Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) — building, integrating, or consuming MCP servers
Hands-on experience with LLM observability tooling (Arize, Braintrust, Datadog LLM monitoring, LangSmith, or custom tracing solutions)
Familiarity with RAG architectures — embedding models, vector stores, retrieval strategies, and quality evaluation
Exposure to prompt injection testing, LLM security, and guardrail implementation
Experiencing managing a search platform such as Glean, Gemini Enterprise Apps
Familiarity with real-time inference architectures including serverless patterns with AWS Lambda
Understanding of semantic caching, intelligent model routing, or FinOps for LLM cost optimization
Background in a SaaS or enterprise software environment
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to debug across LLM application layers — from prompt behavior to infrastructure
Solid communication skills and the ability to work cross-functionally with data scientists, product managers, and engineers.

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
About The Role

We are building AI capabilities that improve important human workflows across the company. As AI Architect, you will set the technical direction for how we design, evaluate, integrate, and operate AI systems. You will help teams choose the right approach for each problem—from conventional software and deterministic workflows to retrieval-augmented systems and agents—and ensure those systems meet clear standards for quality, reliability, safety, and value.

This is a strategic, hands-on role. You will establish reusable architecture and evaluation practices, guide cross-functional teams, and prototype or validate key patterns where needed. You will partner with product and engineering leaders to turn high-value opportunities into systems that can be measured and operated in production.

What You'll Do

Set AI architecture direction: define reference architectures and design principles for AI services, agents, model integrations, data and context flows, tools, and human review. Make trade-offs among quality, autonomy, reliability, latency, cost, and complexity.
Build the evaluation discipline: help teams define expected behavior and success measures; design representative datasets and evaluation methods; write and maintain evals; establish regression checks and quality thresholds; and use results to prioritize improvements.
Guide production readiness: shape shared practices for tracing and observability, versioning, monitoring, incident response, privacy, security, and lifecycle management of AI systems.
Enable teams to ship: create reusable patterns, reference implementations, and practical guidance. Coach engineers through architecture reviews and help teams move valuable work from prototype to production.
Connect architecture to outcomes: partner with product, operations, and domain teams to identify workflow needs and measure whether AI improves completion, quality, time, or other agreed outcomes.
Stay close to implementation: prototype high-risk or foundational designs, review critical implementations, and use production evidence to refine architecture.
Track the evolving ecosystem: evaluate models, agent runtimes, orchestration approaches, and evaluation tooling against our requirements, and recommend adoption based on evidence.

What We're Looking For

At least 8 years of experience in backend software development.
At least 3 years of experience in AI architecture with demonstrated organization-wide impact.
Strong experience designing and delivering production software systems, with substantial work on AI/ML-powered products or services.
A track record of setting technical direction across teams and influencing decisions through evidence and collaboration.
Practical understanding of LLM applications, including retrieval and context construction, tool use, agent patterns, model selection, and failure handling.
Experience defining quality expectations and building evaluations for AI behavior; able to connect offline evaluations to production outcomes.
Sound judgment about where AI is appropriate and when a simpler deterministic approach is better.
Experience with production concerns such as observability, privacy and security, reliability, cost, latency, and safe human escalation.
Clear communication across engineering, product, and executive audiences, with a builder's mindset and comfort prototyping and reviewing implementation.

Helpful Experience

Establishing shared AI platforms, service patterns, or architecture standards across multiple teams.
Creating evaluation datasets, test harnesses, regression suites, or quality dashboards for LLM or agent systems.
Operating AI products with measurable user or business outcomes.
Working with cloud AI platforms, model APIs, agent frameworks, tracing/evaluation tools, and data platforms. Adaptable judgment matters more than one vendor's tools.

The posted pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the compensation for this position and is subject to change based on business need. To determine a successful candidate’s starting pay, we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location, an evaluation of the candidate’s skills and experience, market demands, and internal parity.For roles with on-target-earnings (OTE), the pay range includes both base salary and target incentive compensation. Target incentive compensation for some roles may include a ramping draw period. Compensation is higher for those who exceed targets. Candidates may receive more information from the recruiter.

Pay Range: $129,600 USD - $288,000 USD

Human oversight:
Metaview does not automatically reject candidates or make final hiring decisions. Our recruiters and hiring managers review all outputs and make the final hiring decision regarding every application.

Your rights: If you prefer to have your application reviewed without AI assistance, you may request a human evaluation by entering your email here. Your decision to do so will not affect how your candidacy is evaluated.

Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About The Team

Agent Factory is where Workday’s next chapter gets built. We’re forming small, senior, cross-functional AI teams that bring together product leaders, AI engineers, and full-stack builders to create intelligent agents used by millions of people every day. This is production-grade AI—deeply embedded into Workday’s platform—not research experiments or maintenance work. Teams own problems end to end, collaborate tightly across disciplines, and use the right tools to solve real customer challenges at global scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI, platform architecture, and human workflows, with the autonomy to shape how agents reason, act, and scale responsibly. High trust, high expectations, and real impact. Engineering, but brighter.

About The Role

As a Principal Software Engineer, Agentic UX in Agent Factory, you’ll help build the conversational AI experience and ambient capabilities that bring Workday’s agents to life. You are an AI-native builder, not a pure frontend developer. You will own features end-to-end, connecting the agentic logic directly to the user interface. You don't just build UI; you orchestrate the agentic flows that power the UX. You’ll design and ship experiences that bridge the gap between AI capabilities and user intent. This role is about turning powerful technology into products people actually use: scalable, reliable systems that simplify complex business processes. You’ll collaborate closely with AI engineers, software engineers, product managers, and designers, ensuring that the interface is a seamless extension of the agent's reasoning. If you enjoy building real products and solving meaningful problems at the intersection of AI and human workflows, you'll feel right at home here.

Your responsibilities:

Design and deliver intuitive conversational and agentic AI experiences, prioritizing seamless user interactions and thoughtful workflows.
Shape how users experience AI reasoning by bridging the gap between powerful agent capabilities and clear, usable interfaces.
Collaborate in an iterative, team-first environment that values strong engineering practices and continuous learning
Share knowledge, mentor teammates, and help raise the technical bar across the pod

About You

Basic Qualifications:

12+ years experience in software engineering
7+ years experience building and shipping user-facing software products (TypeScript/React, Python/FastAPI preferred)
3+ years experience building conversational or agentic AI applications
5+ years experience leading projects or teams

Other Qualifications:

Experience collaborating with product designers, or a demonstrated portfolio focusing on high-quality UX/UI design principles
Experience building and operating SaaS products in cloud environments (AWS preferred)
Familiarity with the tradeoffs and architecture of modern distributed systems
Knowledge of software development best practices (DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability)
Hands-on experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
Familiarity with Elasticsearch
Exposure to additional programming languages like Java (backend) and TypeScript (frontend/fullstack) is a plus

jobs.title: People Integrations and AI Architect
jobs.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR
, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

This role will shape how our People technology ecosystem connects, automates and evolves as Legora scales. You'll own the integration architecture that connects our core HRIS to our wider technology stack, while building the AI-native capabilities that make it easier for employees, managers and the People team to get things done.

You'll join at a pivotal moment as we build the foundations of our global People technology ecosystem, helping us make the right architectural decisions from day one. You will build the hard pieces yourself, and make HRIS data and workflows usable by agents, automations, and MCP servers, creating new ways of interacting with People technology.

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines deep integration engineering expertise with a passion for emerging technology. You'll work closely with People Technology, IT, Security and functional stakeholders who rely on People data, balancing speed and innovation with reliability, security and scalability.

What You'll Own

People Integration Architecture & Strategy. Define and own the integration architecture across our People technology ecosystem, with the HRIS at its core. Establish scalable design patterns, technical standards and governance for how systems exchange data and trigger workflows. Make decisions on when to use HRIS-native capabilities, middleware, APIs or custom solutions, balancing speed, maintainability and long-term scalability.
AI & Intelligent Automation. Build the AI-native integration layer that enables employees, managers and the People team to interact with systems in new ways. Design and develop MCP servers, AI agents and intelligent workflows that securely access People data and execute actions across systems. Identify opportunities to eliminate manual work, enable self-service and bring People processes into the tools employees already use. Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and determine when to leverage existing platforms versus building custom solutions.
Security, Reliability & Governance. Establish the technical controls that make our integrations and AI capabilities secure, observable and dependable. Define standards for authentication, field-level permissions, monitoring, alerting, error handling, retries, testing and auditability. Own the ongoing integration lifecycle, including release testing, documentation, troubleshooting and continuous improvement. Partner with IT, Security and Legal to protect sensitive People data and ensure responsible AI use.
Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence. Act as the technical authority for People integrations and AI architecture. Translate complex business requirements into practical technical solutions, challenge design decisions and establish reusable patterns that accelerate delivery. Partner with engineers, analysts, implementation partners and vendors, reviewing technical designs, sharing expertise and raising engineering standards across the team. Anticipate future needs and ensure our architecture can evolve as Legora grows.

What You'll Bring

10+ years of experience in enterprise integrations, software engineering or technology architecture, including significant hands-on experience designing and building integrations for enterprise HR systems.
Deep technical expertise in integrating major enterprise HRIS platforms, including complex employee data flows, security models, APIs and downstream system dependencies. Experience supporting a global HRIS implementation is highly desirable.
Strong experience with APIs, integration patterns and middleware or iPaaS platforms such as Workato, Boomi or MuleSoft. You understand when to use HRIS-native capabilities versus external integration platforms.
Strong command of REST, SOAP, OAuth 2.0, JSON, XML, XSLT, and webhooks
Experience with at least one scripting language (Python, JavaScript, or similar)
Demonstrated experience taking AI agents or LLM-powered integrations from experimentation into production, including designing secure tool access, managing permissions, implementing human-in-the-loop controls and measuring reliability and impact.
Strong understanding of enterprise security, data privacy and integration governance, including authentication, role-based access, monitoring, auditability and safe deployment practices.
Experience working within security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or SOX, with an understanding of audit requirements, data governance and the handling of sensitive employee information.
A strong product mindset and an understanding of how technology can simplify employee and manager experiences. You look beyond technical requirements to understand the problem being solved and the outcomes you're enabling.
The ability to influence technical direction without formal authority, communicate complex concepts clearly and work effectively across engineering, security and non-technical business teams.
A proactive, hands-on mindset. You're comfortable operating in ambiguity, experimenting with emerging technologies and taking ownership from architecture through to production with a bias to ship, test, and iterate.
Fluency in English, which is our working language.

Why this role

People technology is foundational to how Legora scales. We're building the infrastructure that will support thousands of employees across an increasingly complex global footprint, and this role will shape how that infrastructure works for years to come.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Radical AI is replacing an R&D process that currently takes 10+ years and $100 million to produce a single discovery. Our self-driving lab platform combines AI with autonomous robotics to run experiments, analyze results, and iterate—continuously, without human bottlenecks. For industries like aerospace, automotive, defense, energy, manufacturing, semiconductors, and space, that means breakthroughs in weeks instead of years.

The Role

We're looking for a generalist Machine Learning Engineer to turn ML research into capabilities that hold up in production, inside the platform that runs our autonomous lab. A model that can't be trained reliably, served efficiently, and trusted by the scientists using it doesn't count. Your job is to make sure it does.

You'll work side by side with our ML Researchers: designing experiments together, building training pipelines, evaluating models, and taking what works into production. You'll own the engineering that makes that possible, from data preparation and reproducible training to inference performance, product integration, and monitoring after release. Nobody hands you a spec; you'll help decide what's worth building, then build it.

This is a hands-on role across the full ML lifecycle. One week you're in the weeds with a researcher, debugging a training run or implementing a new approach. The next you're standing up a serving endpoint, running down a production failure, or rebuilding the pipeline that gets the next model into users' hands.

This is not a research role, and it's not a pure infrastructure role. We need strong software engineering fundamentals, real experience training and deploying models, and the judgment to trade model quality against reliability, latency, and cost, and to defend those calls when researchers push back. If your instinct is to hand off a model rather than own how it performs, or to wait for clear requirements before moving, this isn't the right fit. Success is simple: research improvements become measurable improvements in Radical's product.

What You'll Work On

Partner with ML Researchers. Turn research ideas into working implementations, co-design experiments, and surface engineering constraints before they become blockers.
Build and run training pipelines. Own the workflows for training and fine-tuning models: datasets, configurations, failure triage, and compute efficiency.
Make experiments reproducible. Track code, data, environments, and model artifacts so any result can be reproduced and built on with confidence.
Evaluate models for product use. Build the datasets and tests that measure model quality, expose failure modes, and decide, with evidence, whether a candidate is ready to ship.
Deploy and integrate models. Turn research code into tested, maintainable components and services, and work with product and platform engineers to put them into real scientific workflows.
Improve inference performance. Profile and optimize latency, throughput, memory, and cost without giving up the quality the product depends on.
Own performance after launch. Monitor model and service behavior, run down regressions, keep releases and rollbacks safe, and feed what you learn into the next round of research.
Improve how the team ships ML. Build the shared tooling and automation that shrink the path from a promising experiment to a dependable product capability.

What We're Looking For

You've taken ML models from experimentation and training all the way into production, and owned the systems that kept them running.
4+ years in ML engineering, research engineering, or a closely related software engineering role.
Strong Python and real software engineering discipline: testing, code review, packaging, and system design that someone else can maintain.
Deep hands-on experience with PyTorch or a comparable framework. You've implemented, trained, evaluated, and debugged models yourself, not just called them.
A working command of dataset quality, train/validation splits, overfitting, data leakage, and why offline metrics so often lie about production performance.
Experience building data pipelines on cloud infrastructure, with containers and GPU workloads.
Experience deploying models through services or batch pipelines, with real attention to observability, reliability, and operating cost.
You engage with researchers as a peer, not through a translator. You pick up unfamiliar approaches quickly and make sound implementation calls while the requirements are still moving.
A generalist's range and an owner's instinct. You move between model code, data, infrastructure, and product integration, and you don't stop until the whole system works.
Able to work on-site at the Brooklyn Navy Yard.

Nice to Have

Experience with LLM training or fine-tuning, model serving, or agent systems.
Distributed training, GPU profiling, or inference optimization experience.
Familiarity with experiment tracking, dataset and model versioning, and automated model release workflows.
Experience with scientific ML, optimization, reinforcement learning, or sequential decision-making.
A background in scientific computing, materials, chemistry, robotics, or lab automation.
Experience shipping ML on a small team where the roadmap changes as fast as the science.

What Success Looks Like

In your first six to twelve months:
Models built with our researchers are live in Radical's product and delivering measurable improvements.
Training and evaluation workflows are reproducible and reliable, and the rest of the team actually uses them.
Every model release has clear quality criteria, automated checks, production monitoring, and a rollback path that works.
The path from promising experiment to production release is measurably faster and far less manual.
Production failures and user feedback flow directly into new datasets, evaluations, and research priorities.
Model quality, inference performance, and operating cost are understood, tracked, and improved together, not traded off by accident.

Work Arrangement

This role is fully in person at our lab in the Brooklyn Navy Yard. We're an in-person team.

Compensation and Benefits

Compensation varies based on experience and scope. We offer 100% employer-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance, unlimited PTO, 14+ company holidays, 2 weeks of company shutdown at EOY, 401(k), and mental health support.

The Opportunity

You'll own the technical path from customer evaluation to silicon design and win on a genuinely novel architecture, the Quadric Chimera GPNPU, which runs everything from CNNs to LLMs to arbitrary C++ on one core, with no fallback processor. Unlike a FAANG solutions role, you'll work the entire stack: quantization, custom kernels, and compiler and your fingerprints will be on chips that ship in cars, cameras, and network appliances.

At a Series C company, every design win has outsized impact. Our FDEs also build with frontier agentic tooling (Claude Code–based agentic workflows) — you won't just be supporting the product, you'll be inventing how edge-AI field engineering is done.

What You'll Do

Own the Technical Path to Design Win

Convert 2–3 active customer evaluations into committed design wins by getting customer workloads running at target latency and accuracy on Chimera.
Port customer workloads onto Chimera — architect, adapt, profile, and write custom kernels when required.

Embed with Customer Engineering Teams

Work on-site and remotely with customer engineering teams: debug failures, hit benchmark targets, and guide model-architecture tradeoffs.
Drive evaluations forward end-to-end, from first technical conversation through design win.

Build the Agentic FDE Toolkit

Codify what you learn into reusable assets — SDK skills, porting playbooks, and agentic content — so each subsequent engagement moves faster than the last.
Build applications and benchmark collateral that support future customer engagements.

Close the Loop Internally

Partner with engineering and product teams to relay customer learnings and shape the roadmap.
Contribute skills and playbooks to Quadric's growing agentic FDE toolset.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6–12 months, you'll:

Convert 2–3 active customer evaluations into committed design wins on the Chimera platform.
Build deep fluency across the Chimera stack — quantization, custom kernels, and compiler tooling — well enough to unblock customers independently.
Establish reusable SDK skills and porting playbooks that measurably shorten the next engagement's timeline.
Become a trusted technical partner to customer engineering teams, known for translating ambiguous requirements into shipped results.
Help define and refine Quadric's agentic (Claude Code–based) FDE workflow — there's no existing playbook yet; you'll help write it.

What We're Looking For

Required

Strong C++ and Python; has written performance-critical code for a constrained target (DSP, NPU, GPU, or embedded SoC).
Systems-level performance intuition — memory bandwidth, data movement, cycle-level reasoning — and can read a profile and know where the time went.
High agency and independent problem-solving; methodical and empirical rather than theoretical.
Comfortable operating without a playbook and in ambiguity — this role is still being defined.

Preferred

Prior FAE, Sales Engineering, or FDE title — or startup experience as the de facto owner of an end-to-end implementation.
Familiarity with agentic dev tooling (Claude Code, MCP) — or strong enthusiasm to adopt it.
Background at NPU/edge-AI IP and silicon companies
Background at inference-focused startups in field/customer engineering or kernel teams.
FDE experience — candidates with embedded or ML-systems backgrounds.
Experience at technical trading arms optimizing kernels or hardware for speed
Big-firm consulting background, provided the candidate personally did the hands-on technical work rather than managing it.

What we offer

The base salary range for this position is $170,000 to $230,000. This range reflects the full span of levels and geographies at which Quadric hires for this role. The actual base salary offered will depend on a number of factors, including the specific level of the role, years and depth of relevant experience, technical skills and competencies, the criticality of the role to the business, internal equity, and work location. About the Role

As a Principal Recommendation System/Platform Engineer, you will lead the upgrade of our core recommendation architecture and recommendation model platform, transforming our existing rule-based personalization system into an industrial-grade, large-scale, real-time ML recommendation platform. This role spans key business scenarios, including trading products, content feeds, the community, and AI-powered investment workflows such as TradeGPT.
You will work closely with recommendation algorithm, growth product and operations, and data science teams to build a high-throughput, low-latency, highly available foundation for personalization at scale, serving more than 80 million users globally. You will lead architectural decisions, infrastructure development, and end-to-end delivery, taking the platform from zero to one in a resource-constrained, fast-moving environment.

Key Responsibilities

Develop high-throughput, low-latency recommendation services. Continuously improve system performance and reliability, and establish robust degradation and disaster-recovery mechanisms.
Build and optimize large-scale model training infrastructure, including distributed training, job scheduling, resource management, fault recovery, and training observability. Improve training efficiency, stability, and resource utilization.
Build model deployment capabilities and high-performance online inference services. Optimize model loading, inference latency, throughput, and infrastructure cost; implement autoscaling, canary releases, graceful degradation, and disaster recovery to ensure service availability under high traffic.
Establish an engineering feedback loop from offline evaluation and online experimentation to production monitoring. Monitor model quality, service performance, and anomalies; build alerting capabilities to support incident diagnosis and safe rollback.
Collaborate with recommendation algorithm and business engineering teams to identify common needs across trading products, content feeds, community, and other recommendation scenarios. Standardize training, deployment, and inference capabilities to bring models into production reliably and efficiently.

Major Requirements

At least 4 years of recommender systems engineering experience at a consumer-facing internet company. You have contributed substantially to the design and development of a model training platform, model deployment platform, or large-scale online inference service, and have hands-on experience resolving production issues.
Strong computer science fundamentals and proficiency in at least one of Go, Java, or C++. You write well-structured code, apply sound design principles, and enjoy tackling challenging engineering problems.
Familiarity with at least one mainstream deep learning framework, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. You understand the end-to-end workflow of training, exporting, deploying, and serving recommendation models, and have practical experience with distributed training or training job orchestration.
An understanding of the recommendation system lifecycle and the engineering considerations involved in sequence models, multi-objective models, and other recommender model types. You can work with algorithm teams to turn model requirements into reusable, maintainable production platform capabilities.
Experience designing and optimizing high-throughput, low-latency services. You can diagnose and resolve online inference issues involving throughput, P99 latency, reliability, and resource cost.

Nice-to-have:

Architecture experience in search, advertising, or recommendations at major technology companies
Experience leading the development of a training platform, model deployment platform, or online inference pipeline from the ground up in a large-scale recommendation, advertising, or search system, and making those capabilities reusable across business scenarios.
Experience optimizing distributed training or inference for complex recommendation models, or scheduling heterogeneous CPU/GPU resources.
Experience with cross-region high-availability deployments, active-active architectures, model release governance, or large-scale production incident response.
An AI-driven approach and hands-on experience bringing LLM or agent applications into production for search, advertising, or recommendation use cases.

Why Join Us

A multi-domain recommendation challenge in fintech:
Go beyond a single domain such as video or e-commerce. You will build personalization capabilities across trading products, market intelligence, community content, campaigns, and AI-powered investment workflows.
Proven business impact with substantial room for ML advancement:
Our current recommendation system has demonstrated a 71% increase in CTR and a 1,285% increase in conversion rate, with significant potential for an ML-native upgrade.
Work at the intersection of AI and recommendations:
Build where traditional recommender systems, generative AI, and LLM agents meet—one of the most active frontiers in engineering.
An opportunity to lead, not just follow:
Our combination of trading, content, community, AI, and campaigns creates distinctive technical challenges and enables rapid iteration.
Global scale:
Serve more than 80 million users across over 200 countries, tackling the real-world complexity of large-scale, real-time systems.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist - Experimentation & Causal Inference
to serve as the statistical brain behind our rapidly growing experimentation program. You will own the methodology layer that ensures every experiment we run is trustworthy, sensitive, and correctly interpreted.
You will NOT be building infrastructure or writing backend services — our platform engineering team handles that. Your job is to design, validate, and continuously improve the statistical frameworks that sit on top of the platform. You will be the person the team turns to when they ask "Can we trust this result?" — and you will build the automated systems that answer that question before anyone needs to ask.
Team context:
You will join a team of data scientists and platform engineers within the Big Data group, reporting to the Head of Big Data. The experimentation platform engineering team implements your specifications into production systems.

Responsibility

Guardrail Metrics & SRM Detection

Design and maintain automated anomaly detection for live experiments — including Sample Ratio Mismatch (SRM) checks and traffic split validation.
Define alerting thresholds and circuit-breaking criteria so compromised experiments are flagged or stopped before polluting decisions.
Define and validate guardrail metrics (sensitivity, directionality, interpretability) that protect the business during every experiment.

Variance Reduction & Sensitivity

Implement and iterate on CUPED and related pre-experiment covariate adjustment methods to reduce metric variance.
Develop techniques to remove noise from user historical behavior, enabling faster detection of true treatment effects — especially in limited-traffic or high-priority scenarios.
Example of impact we are targeting:
Shorten average experiment duration from 14 days to 9 days, unlocking 40%+ more experiments per quarter.

Continuous A/A Experiment Monitoring

Design and run continuous A/A experiments as an always-on health check for the data pipeline (from client-side event reporting through message queues to the real-time data warehouse).
Monitor metric baseline volatility and pipeline stability, ensuring the instrumentation layer remains trustworthy over time. You define what "healthy" looks like; the platform team implements the monitoring infrastructure.

Other responsibilities

Partner with product, engineering, and growth teams on experiment design: sample size calculations, metric selection, duration estimation, and result interpretation. Advise on causal inference methods (DID, synthetic control, RDD) when randomization is not feasible.
Translate your methods into specifications, validation scripts, and decision frameworks that the team can operationalize — enabling experiment owners to self-serve while maintaining rigor.

Requirements

Education:
MS or PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, Economics (Econometrics), Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
Experience:
3+ years of industry experience designing and analyzing online controlled experiments at a tech company with meaningful user scale (not exclusively survey experiments or clinical trials).
Core Statistical Knowledge:
Solid foundations in hypothesis testing, power analysis, multiple testing correction, and sequential testing. Hands-on experience with at least two of: variance reduction methods (CUPED or similar), sample ratio mismatch detection, or continuous data quality monitoring for experiments.
Programming:
Proficient in Python (scipy, statsmodels, or equivalent) for statistical analysis and simulation. Comfortable writing complex SQL (window functions, CTEs) for data extraction and validation.
Communication & Collaboration:
Ability to explain complex statistical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, translate business questions into rigorous experimental designs, and define clear specifications so engineers can implement your methods in production.
AI-Native Workflow:
Strong AI Sense — extensive hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, OpenClaw, or similar). Demonstrated ability to leverage AI assistants to automate repetitive analytical tasks, accelerate code development, and build self-serve tooling faster. You treat AI tools as a daily productivity multiplier, not a novelty.

Nice-to-Haves
Familiarity with Bayesian experimentation frameworks or multi-armed bandit approaches.
Understanding of real-time streaming data pipelines (Kafka, Flink) — not as an engineer, but how data flow affects statistical validity.
Publications or conference presentations on experimentation methodology or causal inference (KDD, WSDM, CIKM, NeurIPS CausalML workshop, or equivalent).
Experience in fintech, crypto, or high-frequency trading domains where user behavior has high variance and fast-moving baselines.

You will partner with product and engineering leaders to turn high-value opportunities into systems that can be measured and operated in production.

What You'll Do

Set AI architecture direction: define reference architectures and design principles for AI services, agents, model integrations, data and context flows, tools, and human review. Make trade-offs among quality, autonomy, reliability, latency, cost, and complexity.

Connect architecture to outcomes: partner with product, operations, and domain teams to identify workflow needs and measure whether AI improves completion, quality, time, or other agreed outcomes.
Stay close to implementation: prototype high-risk or foundational designs, review critical implementations, and use production evidence to refine architecture.
Track the evolving ecosystem: evaluate models, agent runtimes, orchestration approaches, and evaluation tooling against our requirements, and recommend adoption based on evidence.

What We're Looking For

At least 8 years of experience in backend software development.
At least 3 years of experience in AI architecture with demonstrated organization-wide impact.
Strong experience designing and delivering production software systems, with substantial work on AI/ML-powered products or services.
A track record of setting technical direction across teams and influencing decisions through evidence and collaboration.
Practical understanding of LLM applications, including retrieval and context construction, tool use, agent patterns, model selection, and failure handling.
Experience defining quality expectations and building evaluations for AI behavior; able to connect offline evaluations to production outcomes.
Sound judgment about where AI is appropriate and when a simpler deterministic approach is better.
Experience with production concerns such as observability, privacy and security, reliability, cost, latency, and safe human escalation.
Clear communication across engineering, product, and executive audiences, with a builder's mindset and comfort prototyping and reviewing implementation.

Helpful Experience

Creating evaluation datasets, test harnesses, regression suites, or quality dashboards for LLM or agent systems.
Operating AI products with measurable user or business outcomes.
Working with cloud AI platforms, model APIs, agent frameworks, tracing/evaluation tools, and data platforms. Adaptable judgment matters more than one vendor's tools.

new_jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Agentic UX
new_jobs.description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About The Team

Agent Factory is where Workday’s next chapter gets built. We’re forming small, senior, cross-functional AI teams that bring together product leaders, AI engineers, and full-stack builders to create intelligent agents used by millions of people every day. This is production-grade AI—deeply embedded into Workday’s platform—not research experiments or maintenance work. Teams own problems end to end, collaborate tightly across disciplines, and use the right tools to solve real customer challenges at global scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI, platform architecture, and human workflows, with the autonomy to shape how agents reason, act, and scale responsibly. High trust, high expectations, and real impact. Engineering, but brighter.

About The Role

As a Principal Software Engineer, Agentic UX in Agent Factory, you’ll help build the conversational AI experience and ambient capabilities that bring Workday’s agents to life. You are an AI-native builder, not a pure frontend developer. You will own features end-to-end, connecting the agentic logic directly to the user interface. You don't just build UI; you orchestrate the agentic flows that power the UX. You’ll design and ship experiences that bridge the gap between AI capabilities and user intent. This role is about turning powerful technology into products people actually use: scalable, reliable systems that simplify complex business processes. You’ll collaborate closely with AI engineers, software engineers, product managers, and designers, ensuring that the interface is a seamless extension of the agent's reasoning. If you enjoy building real products and solving meaningful problems at the intersection of AI and human workflows, you'll feel right at home here.

Your responsibilities:

Design and deliver intuitive conversational and agentic AI experiences, prioritizing seamless user interactions and thoughtful workflows.
Shape how users experience AI reasoning by bridging the gap between powerful agent capabilities and clear, usable interfaces.
Collaborate in an iterative, team-first environment that values strong engineering practices and continuous learning
Share knowledge, mentor teammates, and help raise the technical bar across the pod

About You

Basic Qualifications:

12+ years experience in software engineering
7+ years experience building and shipping user-facing software products (TypeScript/React, Python/FastAPI preferred)
3+ years experience building conversational or agentic AI applications
5+ years experience leading projects or teams

Other Qualifications:

Experience collaborating with product designers, or a demonstrated portfolio focusing on high-quality UX/UI design principles
Experience building and operating SaaS products in cloud environments (AWS preferred)
Familiarity with the tradeoffs and architecture of modern distributed systems
Knowledge of software development best practices (DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability)
Hands-on experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
Familiarity with Elasticsearch
Exposure to additional programming languages like Java (backend) and TypeScript (frontend/fullstack) is a plus
Proven success working within fast-paced, agile environments and cross-functional teams
Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical partners
Comfortable working with ambiguity and translating complex problems into clear, thoughtful solutions
Committed to fostering an inclusive, team-oriented environment and contributing to a culture of continuous improvement

Workday Pay Transparency Statement

The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here.

Primary Location: USA.CA.Pleasanton

Primary Location Base Pay Range: $246,000 USD - $370,000 USD

Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $206,000 USD - $370,000 USD

Our Approach to Flexible Work

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field
with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

We are seeking a hands-on Solutions Architect with deep expertise in backend infrastructure, inference and cloud-native applications to design and scale Kubernetes-native environments for distributed Robotics workloads. This role offers an outstanding chance to build within the rapidly growing field of Robotics AI & Simulation. You’ll work closely with our product management, engineering, and business teams to drive the adoption of NVIDIA's groundbreaking Physical AI technologies with our key ecosystem partners!

What You’ll Be Doing

Help partners build scalable, observable, GPU-accelerated Physical AI pipelines through agentic workflows, cloud-native technologies, and NVIDIA frameworks such as OSMO.
Support development of Physical AI data factories for data ingestion, preprocessing, annotation, filtering, synthetic data generation, training, simulation, and evaluation.
Develop a deep understanding of robotics workload scaling and translate customer requirements into optimized cloud-native architectures, improving scheduling, cost, storage access, networking, and GPU utilization across hybrid infrastructure.

Experience with scaling Robotics workloads in one or more areas, such as multimodal model training, inference, robot learning and simulation, large scale data processing and generation.
Strong hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating Kubernetes-based platforms for distributed GPU and AI workloads.
Expertise in networking (DNS, LB, TCP/IP, firewalls), storage technology, workflow orchestration softwares (Airflow, Argo, etc), modern DevOps practices (GitOps, IaC, Observability), and orchestrating efficient GPU workloads
Excellent communication skills to convey technical concepts to diverse audiences.

new_jobs.title: People Integrations and AI Architect
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR
, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

This role will shape how our People technology ecosystem connects, automates and evolves as Legora scales. You'll own the integration architecture that connects our core HRIS to our wider technology stack, while building the AI-native capabilities that make it easier for employees, managers and the People team to get things done.

You'll join at a pivotal moment as we build the foundations of our global People technology ecosystem, helping us make the right architectural decisions from day one. You will build the hard pieces yourself, and make HRIS data and workflows usable by agents, automations, and MCP servers, creating new ways of interacting with People technology.

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines deep integration engineering expertise with a passion for emerging technology. You'll work closely with People Technology, IT, Security and functional stakeholders who rely on People data, balancing speed and innovation with reliability, security and scalability.

What You'll Own

People Integration Architecture & Strategy. Define and own the integration architecture across our People technology ecosystem, with the HRIS at its core. Establish scalable design patterns, technical standards and governance for how systems exchange data and trigger workflows. Make decisions on when to use HRIS-native capabilities, middleware, APIs or custom solutions, balancing speed, maintainability and long-term scalability.
AI & Intelligent Automation. Build the AI-native integration layer that enables employees, managers and the People team to interact with systems in new ways. Design and develop MCP servers, AI agents and intelligent workflows that securely access People data and execute actions across systems. Identify opportunities to eliminate manual work, enable self-service and bring People processes into the tools employees already use. Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and determine when to leverage existing platforms versus building custom solutions.
Security, Reliability & Governance. Establish the technical controls that make our integrations and AI capabilities secure, observable and dependable. Define standards for authentication, field-level permissions, monitoring, alerting, error handling, retries, testing and auditability. Own the ongoing integration lifecycle, including release testing, documentation, troubleshooting and continuous improvement. Partner with IT, Security and Legal to protect sensitive People data and ensure responsible AI use.
Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence. Act as the technical authority for People integrations and AI architecture. Translate complex business requirements into practical technical solutions, challenge design decisions and establish reusable patterns that accelerate delivery. Partner with engineers, analysts, implementation partners and vendors, reviewing technical designs, sharing expertise and raising engineering standards across the team. Anticipate future needs and ensure our architecture can evolve as Legora grows.

What You'll Bring

10+ years of experience in enterprise integrations, software engineering or technology architecture, including significant hands-on experience designing and building integrations for enterprise HR systems.
Deep technical expertise in integrating major enterprise HRIS platforms, including complex employee data flows, security models, APIs and downstream system dependencies. Experience supporting a global HRIS implementation is highly desirable.
Strong experience with APIs, integration patterns and middleware or iPaaS platforms such as Workato, Boomi or MuleSoft. You understand when to use HRIS-native capabilities versus external integration platforms.
Strong command of REST, SOAP, OAuth 2.0, JSON, XML, XSLT, and webhooks
Experience with at least one scripting language (Python, JavaScript, or similar)
Demonstrated experience taking AI agents or LLM-powered integrations from experimentation into production, including designing secure tool access, managing permissions, implementing human-in-the-loop controls and measuring reliability and impact.
Strong understanding of enterprise security, data privacy and integration governance, including authentication, role-based access, monitoring, auditability and safe deployment practices.
Experience working within security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or SOX, with an understanding of audit requirements, data governance and the handling of sensitive employee information.
A strong product mindset and an understanding of how technology can simplify employee and manager experiences. You look beyond technical requirements to understand the problem being solved and the outcomes you're enabling.
The ability to influence technical direction without formal authority, communicate complex concepts clearly and work effectively across engineering, security and non-technical business teams.
A proactive, hands-on mindset. You're comfortable operating in ambiguity, experimenting with emerging technologies and taking ownership from architecture through to production with a bias to ship, test, and iterate.
Fluency in English, which is our working language.

Why this role

People technology is foundational to how Legora scales. We're building the infrastructure that will support thousands of employees across an increasingly complex global footprint, and this role will shape how that infrastructure works for years to come.

You'll have the opportunity to shape our integration architecture from the beginning of our HRIS implementation, while pioneering how AI agents, automation and connected systems transform the employee experience. This is an opportunity to combine deep technical engineering with genuine innovation: building a secure and scalable foundation while creating new ways for people to interact with technology. Your work will directly influence how Legora operates as we grow, enabling faster processes, less manual work and a People function that can move at the speed of the business.

What’s In It For You

Global collaboration: Partner with teams and clients across Europe, APAC, and North America.
Competitive package: Comprehensive salary, benefits, and tools for success.
Meaningful work: Your efforts shape how thousands of lawyers use AI daily.
In-person environment: Union Square office designed for ambitious builders and company provided lunch daily.
Benefits & Perks: We invest in our people with a comprehensive, thoughtfully designed benefits package: Medical, Dental & Vision
Multiple medical plan options through Aetna and Kaiser Permanente
HSA or Healthcare FSA (based on plan selection)
Dental plans via MetLife
Vision plans via Vision Care

Family Support

Generous parental leave
Free access to Maven Clinic
Dependent Care FSA
Free One Medical membership for employees and dependents

Additional Perks

Pre-tax commuter benefits
Life Insurance + STD/LTD
401(K) with generous company match
Unlimited PTO
Robust voluntary benefits, including identity protection (via Aura), legal coverage via MetLife, pet savings programs, and more

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

About The Team/Role

We are seeking a seasoned Sr. Software Engineer in the North America Mobility organization. This role will sit in the Platform team that focuses on building AI Platform to support the feature development team to build robust features faster. You will contribute to the architecting and realization of our next-generation Agentic AI Platform. Within this capacity, you will be responsible for the design, development, and deployment of autonomous AI agents, skills, MCP servers, AI tools engineered for advanced reasoning, strategic planning, and the orchestration of intricate financial and operational workflows. Operating at the vanguard of generative AI, distributed systems, and fintech, you will empower WEX to deliver highly intelligent, proactive solutions to an expansive global user base.

Our Platform team is dedicated to architecting scalable, robust, and maintainable UI and API platform solutions that empower internal feature development teams to build at velocity. Within the NAM Mobility ecosystem, our products facilitate strategic credit issuance to fleet organizations and their workforce through WEX-branded or co-branded credit instruments, accepted across a vast network of fueling stations and merchant partners. We provide fleet managers and operators with advanced spend orchestration capabilities, encompassing fuel discounts and sophisticated spend controls that permit precise configuration of merchant restrictions, transaction limits, and velocity thresholds to optimize operational efficiency.

Develop public REST APIs using Java and internal gRPC APIs for inter-service and inter-system communication.
Craft systems designs, lead design decisions, and drive alignment with other senior engineers.
Write automated unit tests, integration tests, end-to-end tests, concurrency tests, load/performance tests.
Analyze existing systems to identify bottlenecks, tech debt, and implement scalability, and stability improvements.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other engineers, to define and implement new features.
Conduct code reviews (comment, approve, seek revisions, merge), mentor junior and mid-level engineers, and actively promote engineering best practices.
Dive deep and troubleshoot complex issues, devise fixes, author root cause analysis documents, and ensure lasting performance and reliability.

Maintain robust documentation (design docs, run books, change management docs, and readiness plans).
Provide live-site support for production applications by monitoring systems, ensuring rapid incident resolution, and driving continuous improvement.
Drive cross-team projects as a single-threaded-owner (STO) or tech lead, and actively unblock other engineers to make progress.

Agentic AI & Intelligent Systems

Design and build agentic AI systems and services, enabling autonomous workflows, reasoning, and task execution within Mobility platforms.
Develop AI agents from scratch, including orchestration, tool usage, memory, and multi-step decision-making capabilities.
Implement and scale multi-agent architectures to support complex, distributed use cases across payments and fleet ecosystems.
Integrate systems using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar frameworks to enable secure and scalable interaction between AI agents, APIs, and enterprise data sources.
Build and optimize LLM-powered services (e.g., OpenAI APIs, LangChain) for production-grade performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
Implement evaluation frameworks, observability, and guardrails to ensure correctness, safety, and compliance of AI-driven systems.
Design solutions for context management, memory, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to enhance agent effectiveness.

Experience You'll Bring

5–8 years of professional experience in software engineering
Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms, object-oriented design, and problem-solving skills
Expertise in designing and developing internet-scale services with scalability, availability, security, and reliability design tenets
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and a collaborative and empathetic mindset
Proficiency in backend development, with expertise in Java or C#, frameworks like SpringBoot, building and optimizing RESTful APIs, ODATA framework, and SQL

Experience integrating AI systems with external tools/APIs using MCP or similar protocols

Experience designing systems for scaling AI workloads in production environments
